path_convention: Archive paths are relative to the root of the code repository, not to individual analysis folders.
input_integrity: All archived input and rendering-asset bytes match their reviewed source files; no re-serialization or statistical recalculation was used to create the archives.
controlled_access: Individual-level GTEx donor ages and the derived sample-level GTEx clock objects are not distributed. Authorised local inputs must be obtained under dbGaP permissions.
